text:
Anna: sharing a quick Figma of the p95 strip + minimap with a tiny rug overlay — trying to solve the 'where did that tail come from' problem. link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/p95-rug-minimap (screenshot attached) Mike: I like the minimap idea. two quick thoughts: 1) the range handle feels too narrow for touch, 2) the rug marks are hard to pick out at small widths. can we try bolder marks and a slightly larger hit target? :thinking_face: Sam: agree on hit target. from frontend POV we should avoid extra DOM nodes for every rug tick — maybe render ticks into the canvas layer. that'll keep interaction fast. Jess: small accessibility nits — keyboard focus ring is invisible in the mock. pressed/active styles also need contrast check. also the handle should have aria-label and role=slider so screen readers can move the window. Olivia: +1 to aria. propose we expose aria-valuemin / aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow and announce range label like "Showing 10m–30m (p95 focus)" via aria-live when the user finishes dragging. Anna: updated copy proposal for the tooltip / range summary: "Viewing 5–30m window — p95 = 240ms". shorter than current copy and reads better with SRs. what do people think? :speech_balloon: Mike: much better. also consider a micro-CTA under minimap: "Sync chart to selection" (toggle) — helpful when you want quick focus without permanently changing the global timepicker. Sam: implementation note: if we add a toggle we need to be clear about routing events to the top-level chart vs local view. propose an event: `minimap:focusWindow({start, end, pinned})` — if pinned=false it just animates, if pinned=true it updates global state. Jess: code snippet for aria attributes I tested locally: ```
``` Olivia: also recommend adding keyboard shortcuts for expanding/shrinking the handle: `ArrowLeft/ArrowRight` to nudge by 1%, `Shift+Arrow` for 5%. and ensure the handle announces the new range after each change. Anna: thanks — this is actionable. next steps: I'll push updated mocks with thicker rug marks, 14px hit target on handles, aria attributes, and the micro-CTA. I'll drop the new Figma link here when ready. timeline: EOD tomorrow. :rocket: Mike: perfect — tagging @Sam and @Jess for implementation sync once mocks are live. :+1:
